liamwynne.erd-studio/heartbeat.comment: One anonymous usage summary per UTC day, sent the day after ERD Studio was used. No names, paths, file contents or error text. Raw rows are deleted after 90 days.

installId.comment: Random UUID v4 minted by the extension once per VS Code profile and kept (until 1.6.2 it was replaced every 30 days). Not vscode.env.machineId and not derived from anything about the machine or user.

day.comment: The UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) the counts describe.

extVersion.comment: ERD Studio version (major.minor.patch) that counted the day.

activation.comment: project_found or no_project, for the most recent activation that day.

hasSemanticDir.comment: Whether the dbt project has an .erd-studio folder.

canvasOpens.comment: Diagrams opened that day, capped at 200.

stages.comment: Stages viewed, a subset of [logical, physical].

schemaFormats.comment: Domain file formats opened, a subset of [v5, v4].

manifest.comment: State of dbt's manifest.json when a diagram was opened: ok, missing, stale or unknown.

catalog.comment: Whether a dbt catalog.json was present.

features.comment: Use counts (0-100 each, zero keys omitted) keyed only by: physicalStage, compare, syncPlan, launchClaude, dbtCompile, annotation, autoLayout, addModel, addRelationship, harnessInstallClaude, harnessInstallCopilot, harnessInstallGemini, harnessInstallCodex, migrateV5, feedbackOpened, drawFromDbt, addFromDbt, emptyCanvas, dbtParse, harnessPresent (at most 1: an ERD Studio AI harness file is installed in the open project), and, each at most 1 a day: manifestMissingCanvas / manifestMissingPhysical / manifestMissingDraw / manifestMissingWelcome / manifestMissingRefresh (no dbt manifest.json when opening a Logical canvas, the Physical stage, Draw from dbt, the Welcome panel or Refresh Manifest), manifestNoTargetDir (the dbt artifact folder does not exist), manifestCustomTargetPath (yes/no only: target-path is not the default 'target'; the path itself is never sent), manifestNoDbtFound (no dbt executable found; never runs dbt); plus manifestAfterParse (a missing manifest.json appeared within 10 minutes of Run dbt parse opening its terminal), manifestAppeared (it appeared some other way) and manifestHintDismissed (the Logical-stage missing-manifest hint was dismissed); canvas edit requests by kind: editModel, editColumn, editKey, editDetails (description, grain, alias, role, rationale, meta), editRelationship, editLayout, editAnnotation, editUndo (undo or redo); auto layout duration: layoutUnder1s, layout1to5s, layoutOver5s, layoutFailed; where diagrams come from: domainCreated (the New Domain command), domainCreatedExternal (a domain file appeared that ERD Studio did not write, e.g. from an AI assistant or git); onboarding: walkthroughOpened, gettingStartedOpened, videoHalf, videoEnded, videoError, trySample, setupAiHelper, copyPrompt, openClaude, openCopilotChat; and harnessInstallAgents (the .agents/skills Agent Skills harness was installed).

errors.comment: Failure counts (0-100 each, zero keys omitted) keyed only by: manifestMissing (no longer recorded since 1.6.2), manifestMalformed, manifestTimeout, catalogUnreadable, domainLoad, modelFileParse, layersInvalid, editRejected, migrationFailed, other, and why a model file failed to parse, counted beside modelFileParse: modelFileRead, modelFileYamlIndent, modelFileYamlScalar, modelFileYamlStructure, modelFileYamlDuplicateKey, modelFileYamlOther. Never messages or stack traces.

host.comment: The editor app, from a fixed list: vscode, vscodeInsiders, cursor, windsurf, vscodium, trae, kiro, positron, antigravity or other. The app's own name is never sent.

remote.comment: Where the extension runs: local, ssh, wsl, container, codespaces, web or other. Never a host name.

dev.comment: True when the day included an Extension Development Host or test run, so the author's own testing can be left out.

assistants.comment: AI assistants found on the machine, a subset of [claude, copilot, codex, gemini, cursor]. Detected from installed VS Code extensions, the editor's name and command names on PATH; nothing is run.

harnesses.comment: ERD Studio AI harness files installed (version-marked) in the open project, a subset of [claude, agents, copilot, gemini, codex].

activeDays28.comment: On how many of the last 28 days ERD Studio activated, bucketed: 0, 1, 2-3, 4-7, 8-14, 15-28. Counted on the device; the dates are never sent.

canvasDays28.comment: On how many of the last 28 days a diagram was opened, same buckets. Counted on the device; the dates are never sent.

firstCanvas.comment: Days from first activation to the first diagram opened, bucketed like tenure, or never.
